sloka: मावमम्स्था दशरथम् भर्तारम् वरदम् पतिम् ।भर्तुरिच्छा हि नारीणाम्पुत्रकोट्या विशिष्यते ॥२-३५-८॥
transliteration: māvamamsthā daśaratham bhartāram varadam patim ।bharturicchā hi nārīṇāmputrakoṭyā viśiṣyate ॥2-35-8॥

translations.english: Do not have contempt for Dasaratha who is your husband, nourisher and bestower of boons. For a wife, the desire of her husband is considered worthier than ten million sons.
